text:
elaine: Heads-up: multiple teams reported brittle retry logic in our SDKs. They keep retrying on 403s and hitting rate limits. Can we standardize the error contract so apps don't implement fragile parsing?

hiro: Absolutely. Current state is messy: SDKs expose a one-size ApiError and some helper booleans in a few languages. No consistent `retry_after` mapping or clear 401 vs 403 semantics.

david: We should define both an ergonomic surface and a minimal wire contract. Wire: HTTP status + Retry-After header + a JSON body with `code` (string) and `message`. Ergonomics: typed errors in each SDK with helpers.

anya: Concrete proposal: server returns body like `\{"code\": \"rate_limit\", \"message\": \"quota exceeded\", \"meta\": {\"quota_window\": 60}}`. Then SDK maps `code`+status -> typed exception. This avoids brittle parsing of `message`.

elaine: Agreed. For Retry-After we need deterministic parsing of formats (seconds or HTTP-date). SDKs should expose `retry_after_seconds` normalized to an integer when present. If header missing but `meta.retry_after` present in body, prefer body.

hiro: Language specifics: Python/JS/TS: subclass error classes (client.errors.RateLimit, AuthExpired). Go: implement errors with sentinel types + accessor functions. Example Go pattern: `var ErrRateLimit = errors.New("rate_limit")` plus `type RateLimit interface { error; RetryAfter() (time.Duration, bool) }`.

david: Also recommend `IsRetryable()` method/property instead of `is_transient` so it's explicit about whether automatic retry is safe. Note: 429 with short Retry-After -> retryable; 403 -> not retryable unless body code says `temporary_permission_issue` which is rare.

anya: Streaming nuance: if the SSE/WS stream disconnects with an HTTP 502 then emit a `StreamTerminatedError` with `status_code`, `last_event_id`, and `partial_tokens`. Clients can then surface a resume button.

elaine: Migration/compatibility plan: 1) announce contract change in changelog and SDK changelogs, 2) server will include `code` field for 3 months while SDKs adapt, 3) SDKs add typed errors behind a minor version bump and set a compatibility flag defaulting to old behavior, 4) after deprecation window flip default and then remove old ApiError for next major.

hiro: For message wording we should standardize the human message templates so support sees consistent logs. Examples: RateLimit -> \"Request quota exceeded \t6 retry after {N}s\"; AuthExpired -> \"Authentication failed: token expired\"; PermissionDenied -> \"Access denied: missing scope {scope}\". Keep them short so they show up cleanly in logs.

david: Tests: unit test for header parsing: both `Retry-After: 120` and `Retry-After: Wed, 21 Oct 2015 07:28:00 GMT` -> normalized. E2E: simulate 401 + body.code=\"token_expired\" and assert SDK raises AuthExpired error. Streaming E2E: send 200 stream then inject mid-stream 500, assert `StreamTerminatedError` with `partial_tokens>0`.

anya: CI changes: add cross-language test harness that can hit a local test server which emits the canonical body shape. We'll add this to `sdk/ci/integration` so PRs fail fast on parity regressions.

build-bot: Build: new branch `error-contracts` created by hiro -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/compare/error-contracts :white_check_mark:

elaine: UX docs: add short cookbook snippets for common patterns: show how to handle rate limits, how to refresh tokens on AuthExpired, how to present permission errors to users (include required scope from body.meta). Keep snippets <20 lines.

hiro: One open question: should we keep raw response on the error as `error.raw`? Helpful for debugging but exposes full payload. My vote: keep it but redact sensitive fields (tokens) in the SDK before attaching.

david: Agreed. Also add logging helpers in the SDK to emit structured logs: `logger.error(error).with_fields(status=error.status_code, code=error.code, retry_after=error.retry_after_seconds)`.

anya: Can we include a short migration checklist in the RFC: update server to emit `code`, update SDK parsing, add unit + e2e tests, add doc snippets, announce deprecation window?

elaine: Yes. Hiro/David can draft RFC with examples for all languages. Please include the compatibility table mapping earlier status/message combos to new `code` values.

qa-bot: QA: created test plan ticket INF-4921 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4921

hiro: I'll draft tonight and tag SDK leads. Expect PRs for python/js/go next week.

elaine: Thanks — this should make error handling much less error-prone for integrators and reduce support noise.
